lines.en: The black knight, he is defeating the Paladins so easily!  W-we are doomed...
lines.zh: 黑骑士，他竟然如此轻易地击败了圣骑士！ 我、我们完了……

lines.en: Those cultists can't get inside with my barrier up!  Stand back...
lines.zh: 只要我的结界还在，那些邪教徒就进不来！ 退后…………

lines.en: Do you really think it'll hold?!
The barrier hasn't failed me yet!  Get everyone out of here, Jebediah - don't worry about me!
lines.zh: 这结界还没让我失望过呢！ 耶比底亚，快让大家撤离——别担心我！

lines.en: I-I'm sorry...  You weren't supposed to fight back...
lines.zh: 我、我很抱歉…… 你不应该反击的……

lines.en: You've taught me so much, Grandmaster...  Now I can better serve the true god, Zanatus.  H-he's coming back, you know.  And I'll be among the first to be rewarded...
lines.zh: 圣宗，你教会了我很多…… 现在我可以更好地服务于真正的神，扎纳图斯。 他、他要回来了，你知道嘛。 而我将是第一批得到奖赏的人……
